mechanism: Bumetanide may reduce renal clearance of amoxicillin through competition for renal tubular secretion, potentially increasing amoxicillin levels; additionally, loop diuretics can cause ototoxicity which may be potentiated by beta-lactam antibiotics.
action: Monitor renal function and amoxicillin levels; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretic if ototoxicity risk is high; assess for signs of hearing loss during concurrent use.
